subject: Error trying to upload occ data

messages.author: 876072b5364dcd5b
messages.subject: Error trying to upload occ data
parts:
Hello fellow Wallace users,

I am having problems uploading the occurrence data for the species that I am trying to model. The same error keeps happening, even after I corrected what the message said. This is the message: ! ERROR: Please input a file with columns "scientific_name", "longitude", "latitude".
I am using the latest Wallace version (2.1.1).

If anyone could help me, I would be very thankful.
Best regards,
Gabriel Yan

messages.author: 881c0dd9c7b0d196
messages.subject: Re: Error trying to upload occ data
parts:
Check to make sure the occ data file is a comma-separated values file (.csv), that the columns headers do not have the quotation marks (" "), and that the species' names in the scientific_name column are listed as Genus species, and not with an underscore. 
For a sample of how it should look, see: Bassaricyon_alleni.csv

Bethany
The Wallace Team
